feats.title: Aggressive Advantage
feats.description: You gain combat advantage against all enemies during your first turn in an encounter.

feats.title: Agile Opportunist
feats.description: Whenever you are pulled, pushed, or slid into a square adjacent to an enemy, you can use an immediate reaction to make a basic attack against that enemy.

feats.title: Alchemist
feats.description:
You master the Alchemical Creation ritual, additionally, you learn a formula of your level or lower at 1st level, 2nd level, and every even level thereafter.

*Special*: You can take this feat instead of the Ritual Master feat granted by your class feature.

feats.title: Alertness
feats.description: You cannot be surprised. Also, you gain a +2 feat bonus to Perception checks. At 21st level, this feat bonus increases to +3.

feats.title: Armor Proficiency
feats.description: You gain proficiency with the armor type one step above the highest armor type you are already proficient with, using this progression: Cloth → Leather → Hide → Chainmail → Scale → Plate.

feats.title: Astral Fire
feats.description: You gain a +2 feat bonus to damage rolls when you use a power that has the Fire or the Radiant keyword. At 11th level, this feat bonus increases to +3. At 21st level, it increases to +4.

feats.title: Back to the Wall
feats.description: Whenever you are adjacent to blocking terrain other than the ground, you gain a +1 feat bonus to attack rolls, a +1 bonus to damage rolls against adjacent enemies, and do not grant combat advantage to those enemies. At 11th level, this bonus to damage rolls increases to +2. At 21st level, it increases to +3.

feats.title: Battering Shield
feats.description: When you are wielding a shield and push or slide a creature with a melee or close attack, you gain a +1 feat bonus to the distance of that forced movement. This feat bonus increases to +2 at 21st level.

feats.title: Beguiling Enchantment
feats.description: Whenever you hit an enemy with a charm power, that enemy takes a -2 penalty to attack rolls against you until the end of its next turn.

feats.title: Burning Blizzard
feats.description: You gain a +2 feat bonus to damage rolls when you use a power that has the Acid or the Cold keyword. At 11th level, this feat bonus increases to +3. At 21st level, it increases to +4.

feats.title: Combat Medic
feats.description: You can administer first aid as a minor action with no increase in difficulty. You gain a +2 feat bonus to Medicine checks, increasing to a +3 feat bonus at 21st level.

feats.title: Combat Reflexes
feats.description: Enemies do not gain the normal +2 bonus to attack rolls against you when they have combat advantage. Any other benefits derived from combat advantage still apply.

feats.title: Coordinated Explosion
feats.description: When you use a burst or blast attack, you gain combat advantage against enemy targets if at least one of your allies is targeted by the burst or blast.

feats.title: Danger Sense
feats.description: When you make an initiative check, roll twice and take the higher of the two rolls.

feats.title: Dark Fury
feats.description: You gain a +2 feat bonus to damage rolls when you use a power that has the necrotic or the psychic keyword. At 11th level, this bonus increases to +3. At 21st level, it increases to +4.

feats.title: Deadly Draw
feats.description: Whenever you pull or slide an enemy to a square adjacent to you, you gain combat advantage against that enemy until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Defensive Mobility
feats.description: You do not provoke opportunity attacks when leaving a square adjacent to an enemy as long as you are entering another square adjacent to that enemy.

feats.title: Distant Advantage
feats.description: You gain combat advantage for close, ranged, and area attacks against any enemy flanked by your allies.

feats.title: Durable
feats.description: Your number of healing surges increases by 2. At 11th level, your number of healing surges instead increases by 3, and at 21st level your number of healing surges instead increases by 4.

feats.title: Eager Advance
feats.description: You gain a +4 power bonus to speed on your first turn during an encounter. Increase this bonus to +6 at 11th level and +8 at 21st level.

feats.title: Escape Artist
feats.description: You can attempt to escape a grab as a minor action, instead of as a move action. You also gain a +2 feat bonus to Acrobatics checks. At 21st level, this feat bonus increases to +3.

feats.title: Evasion
feats.description: Whenever an attack misses you and would still inflict damage on a miss, you do not take that damage.

feats.title: Expansive Burst
feats.description: Your close burst and area burst attacks ignore cover, but not superior cover.

feats.title: Far Throw
feats.description: When you make a ranged attack with a thrown weapon or consumable item, increase both the normal range and long range of the attack by your Strength.

feats.title: Fast Runner
feats.description: You gain a +2 bonus to speed whenever you charge or run. At 11th level, this bonus increases to +3. At 21st level, it increases to +4.

feats.title: Fleet-Footed
feats.description: You gain a +1 feat bonus to your speed, increasing to a +2 feat bonus to your speed at 21st level.

feats.title: Grounding Shot
feats.description: Your ranged attacks ignore the penalty for attacking prone targets and deal 2 extra damage against them. Increase this extra damage to 4 at 11th level and 6 at 21st level.

feats.title: Hafted Defense
feats.description: While wielding a polearm, spear, or staff in two hands, you gain a +1 shield bonus to AC and Reflex.

feats.title: Hammering Iron
feats.description: Whenever you hit a target with a basic attack using a hammer, you can also push that target 1 square.

feats.title: Headsman's Chop
feats.description: You gain a +2 feat bonus to weapon damage rolls with axes and heavy blades. This feat bonus increases to +3 at 11th level and +4 at 21st level. Against prone targets, this feat bonus is doubled.

feats.title: Improved Bull Rush
feats.description: You can Bull Rush creatures of any size. Whenever you use the Bull Rush option, you deal 4 extra damage, plus 4 extra damage for each size category smaller than you the target is. The extra damage increases to 6 at 11th level, and 8 at 21st level.

feats.title: Improved Grab
feats.description: You can use the Grab attack on creatures of any size. When you use the Grab attack on a creature two or more sizes larger than you that creature is not immobilized, but instead must pull you one square to a square adjacent to them whenever they move, and fails to move if they cannot do so. Whenever you sustain a grab, the grabbing power deals 1[W] damage (occupied weapon or unarmed weapon) to the target.

feats.title: Improved Initiative
feats.description: You gain a +4 feat bonus to initiative. This feat bonus increases to +5 at 11th level and +6 at 21st level.

feats.title: Improved Second Wind
feats.description: Whenever you use your Second Wind, you regain additional hit points equal to 5 + half your level.

feats.title: Lasting Frost
feats.description: Once per turn when you deal cold damage to a creature, you can choose to inflict vulnerable 3 to cold damage to that creature until the end of your next turn. The vulnerability inflicted increases to 5 at 11th level and 10 at 21st level.

feats.title: Linguist
feats.description: Choose three languages. You can speak, read, and write those languages fluently. You gain a +2 feat bonus to your choice of Diplomacy, Society, or Insight checks. At 21st level, this feat bonus increases to +3.

feats.title: Long Jumper
feats.description: Whenever you make a long jump with a running start, your jump can take you further than your remaining movement. You gain a +2 feat bonus to Athletics checks. At 21st level, this feat bonus increases to +3.

feats.title: Lost in the Crowd
feats.description: You gain a +2 racial bonus to all defenses when you are adjacent to at least two creatures larger than you.

feats.title: Master at Arms
feats.description:
You gain a +1 tier bonus to the attack rolls of weapon attacks. The bonus increases to +2 at 11th level and +3 at 21st level.

Also, you can use a single minor action to sheathe a weapon and then draw another weapon.

feats.title: Mettle
feats.description: Whenever an attack misses you and would still inflict a condition on a miss, you do not suffer that condition.

feats.title: Nimble Blade
feats.description: When you attack with a dagger or light blade and you have combat advantage, you gain a +1 feat bonus to attack rolls.

feats.title: Oncoming Storm
feats.description: When you hit with any lightning attack power, you gain combat advantage with thunder powers until the end of your next turn. When you hit with any thunder attack power, you gain combat advantage with lightning powers until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Opportunity Sidestep
feats.description: Whenever you hit with an opportunity attack, you can shift 1 square as a free action. Increase this shift to up to 2 squares at 21st level.

feats.title: Opportunistic Shove
feats.description: When making an opportunity attack, you can use the Bull Rush option. On a hit, the target also grants Combat Advantage until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Opportunistic Withdrawal
feats.description: Your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks from enemies granting Combat Advantage to you prior to the movement.

feats.title: Overwhelming Critical
feats.description: Whenever you score a critical hit, you can also knock the target prone.

feats.title: Point-Blank Shot
feats.description: You gain the Prime Shot feature. (If none of your allies are nearer to your target than you are, you have combat advantage with ranged attack rolls against that target.)

feats.title: Polearm Flanker
feats.description: While you are wielding a weapon with the Reach property, you and your ally are flanking an enemy if your ally and a square adjacent to you are adjacent to and on opposite sides or corners of that enemy's space.

feats.title: Power Attack
feats.description: You gain a +2 feat bonus to weapon damage with two-handed weapons, increasing to +3 at 11th level and +4 at 21st level. Additionally, whenever you make a weapon attack with a two-handed weapon, you may choose to take a -2 penalty to the attack roll. If you do so, the feat bonus is doubled for that attack.

feats.title: Powerful Charge
feats.description: Whenever you charge, you deal 3 extra damage with your attack, increasing to 5 extra damage at 11th level and 10 extra damage at 21st level.

feats.title: Power Shot
feats.description: You gain a +2 feat bonus to weapon damage with ranged and thrown weapons, increasing to +3 at 11th level and +4 at 21st level. Additionally, whenever you make a weapon attack with a ranged or thrown weapon, you may choose to take a -2 penalty to the attack roll. If you do so, the feat bonus is doubled for that attack.

feats.title: Quick Draw
feats.description: You can draw a weapon or object as part of the same action used to attack with the weapon or use the object. You also gain a +3 feat bonus to Initiative checks.

feats.title: Raging Storm
feats.description: You gain a +2 feat bonus to damage rolls when you use a power that has the Lightning or Thunder keyword. At 11th level, this feat bonus increases to +3. At 21st level, it increases to +4.

feats.title: Rapid Assault
feats.description: On your first turn during an encounter, you gain a +4 power bonus to damage rolls with melee and ranged attacks. The bonus increases to +6 at 11th level and +8 at 21st level. This bonus is doubled against creatures that are Surprised.

feats.title: Resounding Thunder
feats.description: You can add 1 to the size of any blast that has the thunder keyword. At 21st level, you can add 1 or 2 to the size of any blast that has the thunder keyword and 1 to the size of any burst that has the thunder keyword.

feats.title: Roll with It
feats.description: Whenever an effect pulls, pushes, or slides you, you can shift 1 square as a free action at the end of the forced movement. At 21st level, you can instead shift up to 2 squares at the end of the forced movement.

feats.title: Ritual Master
feats.description: You can master and perform rituals of your level and lower.

feats.title: Seize the Moment
feats.description: During the first round of combat and during surprise rounds, you have combat advantage against any foe whose initiative result is lower than yours. Additionally, whenever you make an initiative check and roll a natural 20, you gain an Action Point.

feats.title: Shield Mastery
feats.description: While wielding a shield with which you have proficiency, your shield bonus also applies to your Fortitude.

feats.title: Shield Specialization
feats.description: Any shield bonuses to defense you receive while wielding a shield with which you are proficient increase by one.

feats.title: Shifting Defense
feats.description: Whenever you use your Second Wind or take the Total Defense action, you can also shift 1 square. At 21st level, you can shift up to 2 squares.

feats.title: Skill Power
feats.description: You gain a skill power of your level or lower from a skill in which you are trained.

feats.title: Skill Training
feats.description: You gain proficiency in two additional skills.

feats.title: Sly Hunter
feats.description: You gain a +2 feat bonus to damage rolls with bow and crossbow attacks. This feat bonus increases to +3 at 11th level and +4 at 21st level. Against any target that has no creature within 3 squares of it, this feat bonus is doubled.

feats.title: Spear Push
feats.description: Whenever you push a foe with a polearm or spear attack, you may add 1 square to the distance pushed, or 2 squares at 21st level or higher.

feats.title: Spring Step
feats.description: You can shift 1 square as a free action when you stand up. At 21st level, you can shift up to 2 squares.

feats.title: Steady Feet
feats.description: Whenever an attack would knock you prone, you can make a saving throw to avoid falling prone. You gain a +2 feat bonus to Endurance checks, increasing to +3 at 21st level.

feats.title: Surging Flame
feats.description: Once per turn when you deal fire damage to a creature, you can choose to inflict vulnerable 3 fire to that creature until the end of your next turn. The vulnerability inflicted increases to 5 at 11th level and 10 at 21st level.

feats.title: Swift Recovery
feats.description: You gain a +3 feat bonus to your healing surge value. This bonus increases to +4 at 11th level and +5 at 21st level.

feats.title: Toughness
feats.description: You gain additional hit points equal to 5 + one half your level. You also gain a +2 feat bonus to Endurance checks. At 21st level, this feat bonus increases to +3.

feats.title: Two-Weapon Defense
feats.description: While you are wielding two melee weapons with which you are proficient, you gain a +1 shield bonus to AC and Reflex.

feats.title: Unarmored Agility
feats.description: You gain a +2 feat bonus to AC while wearing either cloth armor or no armor.

feats.title: Vexing Flanker
feats.description: While you are flanking an enemy, that enemy grants combat advantage to all creatures.

feats.title: Vicious Advantage
feats.description: You gain combat advantage against immobilized, slowed, and weakened targets.

feats.title: Warding Defense
feats.description: Whenever you successfully use the Aid Defense action while carrying a shield with which you are proficient, the chosen ally also shares your shield bonuses to defenses until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Weapon Proficiency
feats.description: You gain proficiency in a single superior weapon of your choice, or all simple and military weapons.

feats.title: Watchful Redoubt
feats.description: You gain a +3 feat bonus to initiative. When you use your Second Wind or the Total Defense action, you can choose to reroll your initiative. Your initiative is set to the result at the start of the next round, even if it is lower.
